in_sanskrit.name: सुधिर
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: सु (su) meaning good, virtuous, pure. धिर (dhira) meaning auspicious, strength, power. The name Sudhira is derived from the Sanskrit word सुधिर (sudhira), which is a combination of the words सु (su) and धिर (dhira).

in_hindi.name: सुधिर
in_hindi.meaning: सुकर्म (sukarm) meaning good deeds, धिर (dhira) meaning strength, power. The name Sudhira is derived from the Hindi words सुकर्म (sukarm) and धिर (dhira).

in_tamil.name: சுதிர
in_tamil.meaning: சு (su) meaning good, திர (thir) meaning auspicious, prosperous. The name Sudhira is derived from the Tamil words சு (su) and திர (thir).

in_telugu.name: సుధిర
in_telugu.meaning: సు (su) meaning good, ధిర (dhira) meaning auspicious, strength, power. The name Sudhira is derived from the Telugu words సు (su) and ధిర (dhira).
